surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 20 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Balad (The City) is the 90th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 20 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ لَا أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا الْبَلَدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم لا اقسم بهذا البلد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: I swear by this city, Makkah
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I swear by this city––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and you [Prophet] are an inhabitant of this city––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [I swear] by parent and offspring

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We have certainly created man into hardship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that We have created man for toil and trial

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَيَحْسَبُ أَنْ لَنْ يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ايحسب ان لن يقدر عليه احد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does he think that no one will have power over him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘I have squandered great wealth,’ he says

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Does he think that no one has seen him
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Does he think no one observes him

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have We not made for him two eyes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Did We not give him eyes

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And a tongue and two lips
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a tongue, lips

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And have shown him the two ways
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and point out to him the two clear ways [of good and evil]

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But he has not broken through the difficult pass
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet he has not attempted the steep path

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What will explain to you what the steep path is

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is the freeing of a slave
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is to free a slave

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَوۡ إِطۡعَٰمࣱ فِي يَوۡمࣲ ذِي مَسۡغَبَةࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَوْ إِطْعَامٌ فِي يَوْمٍ ذِي مَسْغَبَةٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: او اطعام في يوم ذي مسغبة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to feed at a time of hunger

ayahs.translation_saheeh: An orphan of near relationship
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: an orphaned relative

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or a needy person in misery
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: or a poor person in distress

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلصَّبۡرِ وَتَوَاصَوۡاْ بِٱلۡمَرۡحَمَةِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا بِالْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ثم كان من الذين امنوا وتواصوا بالصبر وتواصوا بالمرحمة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Those are the companions of the right
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Those who do this will be on the right-hand side

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِآيَاتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَابُ الْمَشْأَمَةِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والذين كفروا باياتنا هم اصحاب المشامة
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but those who disbelieve in Our revelations will be on the left-hand side

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Over them will be fire closed in
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the Fire will close in on them
